steps_breakdown.name: Email Ingestion & Classification
steps_breakdown.task: Classify incoming email intent (Tax Query, Portfolio Withdrawal, Meeting Request, General Inquiry)
steps_breakdown.why_exists: Filters spam and immediately routes high-priority client requests to correct advisor queues.
steps_breakdown.reason: Fastest TTFT (<200ms) and lowest cost (₹6.26/1M input) for simple classification.

steps_breakdown.name: Attachment OCR & Table Extraction
steps_breakdown.task: Extract unstructured financial tables from attached 15-page bank statement PDF
steps_breakdown.why_exists: Converts scanned images and multi-page PDFs into structured text for downstream analysis.
steps_breakdown.reason: Native 2M token context window and leading MMMU vision score for complex table OCR.

steps_breakdown.name: Portfolio Risk & Tax Analysis
steps_breakdown.task: Analyze portfolio allocation changes, capital gains tax impact, and rebalancing options
steps_breakdown.why_exists: Requires high-precision mathematical reasoning and regulatory tax rule adherence.
steps_breakdown.reason: Ranked #1 globally on Artificial Analysis TAU Banking benchmark (0.3340 score) for financial math.
alt_models: GPT-5.6 Sol (0.3299 TAU score - lower precision)

steps_breakdown.name: Structured CRM Writeback via MCP
steps_breakdown.task: Format client updates into strict JSON schema and execute Salesforce writeback via MCP
steps_breakdown.why_exists: Automates administrative recordkeeping so wealth advisors don't type manually.
steps_breakdown.reason: 100% JSON schema adherence and low input cost (₹25/1M in) for structured outputs.
alt_models: DeepSeek V4 (Risk of 60 RPM rate limit blocking sync API)

steps_breakdown.name: Document Ingestion & GraphRAG Indexing
steps_breakdown.task: Convert 50-page PDF portfolio statements into GraphRAG entity knowledge graph
steps_breakdown.why_exists: Maps complex holding companies, offshore trusts, and family accounts without losing context.
steps_breakdown.reason: Lowest cost (₹36.32/1M input) for high-volume background indexing.

steps_breakdown.name: Tax Harvesting & Mathematical Verification
steps_breakdown.task: Calculate short-term vs long-term capital gains tax harvesting opportunities
steps_breakdown.why_exists: Prevents calculation errors that could lead to tax penalties for high-net-worth clients.
steps_breakdown.reason: #1 SOTA on TAU Banking benchmark (0.3340 score) for financial tax calculations.

steps_breakdown.name: Compliance Audit & Final Report Drafting
steps_breakdown.task: Draft 15,000-word advisory report and verify against EU AI Act & SEBI guidelines
steps_breakdown.why_exists: Ensures report is legally binding, zero-hallucination, and audit-ready.
steps_breakdown.reason: Top global compliance reasoning (60.7 Intelligence Index) for final client artifacts.

steps_breakdown.name: Target Web Crawling & SEC Filing Scraping
steps_breakdown.task: Crawl 10K/10Q filings and news using Crawl4AI and extract raw text
steps_breakdown.why_exists: Aggregates multi-year financial history across public & private disclosures.
steps_breakdown.reason: Unbeatable token cost (₹36.32/1M in) for bulk background extraction.

steps_breakdown.name: Debt Covenant & Contract Legal Audit
steps_breakdown.task: Analyze change-of-control clauses, debt covenants, and material liabilities
steps_breakdown.why_exists: Identifies deal-breaker financial risks before acquisition sign-off.
steps_breakdown.reason: Top global contract analysis & zero-hallucination accuracy.

steps_breakdown.name: Valuation DCF Model Verification
steps_breakdown.task: Perform Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) sensitivity modeling and EBITDA adjustments
steps_breakdown.why_exists: Validates target company purchase price against market benchmarks.
steps_breakdown.reason: #1 globally on TAU Banking (0.3340 score) for complex valuation math.

steps_breakdown.name: Identity Document OCR & Sanctions Check
steps_breakdown.task: Extract passport details and cross-check against OFAC SDN watchlist
steps_breakdown.why_exists: Mandatory regulatory gate under anti-money laundering laws.
steps_breakdown.reason: Top multi-modal document extraction and fast processing.

steps_breakdown.name: Strict JSON Schema Generation
steps_breakdown.task: Format verified KYC fields into strict JSON schema for CRM ingestion
steps_breakdown.why_exists: Ensures zero database insertion errors in core banking backend.
steps_breakdown.reason: 100% structured output schema guarantee at sub-₹25/1M pricing.
